title: 第十章  八翼紫晶狮
content_zh:
转瞬间,便已过半月。

    这半月以来,江尘带着虎芸,一路大杀四方,已经通过了妖兽之林最深处,正向其边缘处杀去。那里是最后计算成绩的地方,名唤听烟霞谷。

    短短半个月时间,江尘与虎芸的组合几乎是无敌的存在。斩杀的妖兽难以计数,两人身上现在的功勋已是不少。虎芸以十五万七千六百点功勋排在了第九名,而江尘则以十七万六千三百五十点排在了第七名。

    此刻,江尘与虎芸也是满脸轻松,干净利落的将一群三眼青狼斩杀殆尽。虎芸对江尘的崇拜已经到了无以复加的地步,每次战斗,江尘的速度以及那干净利落的手法,都让虎芸由衷钦佩不已。

    “芸儿妹妹,你那边加快速度收取妖丹,我感应到似乎有一只实力强大的妖兽,正在向我们这边赶来。”江尘的笑容忽然凝滞,略带疑问似的说道。

    闻言,虎芸不由得加快了速度。当两人收取完妖丹,正欲离开之际。忽然整个大地都开始颤抖起来,发出嗡嗡的声音。

    几乎同时,江尘跟虎芸都看见,一头高数丈,长数十丈的巨大妖兽,正快速向他们而来。

    妖兽浑身都是淡紫色的鳞甲,闪烁着幽幽的紫光。背后八只翅膀呈现出妖艳的血红色,镌刻着古老的符文,每走一步,整个大地仿佛都要塌陷一般。

    江尘跟虎芸来逃走的机会都没有,两人刚想转身,便被一股奇异的力量束缚,连动一下都十分费劲。而那只妖兽便是转瞬间已经到了两人跟前,凶残的眼中迸出精光,仿佛见到食物一般的看着江尘二人。

    “吼,哪里来的小毛孩子,竟敢大肆屠杀本王座下的妖兽,当真以为本王是好欺负的吗?”巨大妖兽竟然口吐人言,怒声喝道。

    江尘跟虎芸都是一愣,半晌竟然说不出话来。

    “难道你们两个都是哑巴?本王问你们话,竟敢不回答,你们还当真不把本王放在眼里吗?”巨大妖兽愤怒一般的吼道。巨大的声音,震得江尘跟虎芸心胆剧烈震动不已,很难平静下来。
content_en:
In the blink of an eye, half a month has passed.

    In the past half month, Jiang Chen has led Hu Yun, killing all the way. He has passed the deepest part of the forest of monsters and is heading towards the edge. That's where the final results are calculated, and it's called Tingyanxia Valley.

    In just half a month, the combination of Jiang Chen and Hu Yun became almost invincible. Countless monsters have been killed, and the two of them now have a lot of achievements. Hu Yun ranked ninth with 157,600 merit points, while Jiang Chen ranked seventh with 176,350 points.

    At this moment, Jiang Chen and Hu Yun also had relaxed faces as they killed a group of three-eyed green wolves cleanly. Hu Yun's admiration for Jiang Chen has reached an extreme level. Every time she fights, Jiang Chen's speed and neat techniques make Hu Yun sincerely admire her.

    "Sister Yun'er, speed up your collection of demon pills. I sense that there seems to be a powerful demon beast coming towards us." Jiang Chen's smile suddenly froze and he said with a hint of doubt.

    Hearing this, Hu Yun couldn't help but speed up. When the two of them had collected the demon pills and were about to leave. Suddenly the whole earth began to tremble and make a buzzing sound.

    Almost at the same time, Jiang Chen and Hu Yun both saw a huge demonic beast several feet tall and dozens of feet long, coming towards them quickly.

    The monster beast is covered in lavender scales, shining with a faint purple light. The eight wings on his back showed a coquettish blood-red color and were engraved with ancient runes. With every step he took, the entire earth seemed to collapse.

    Jiang Chen and Hu Yun had no chance to escape. Just as they wanted to turn around, they were restrained by a strange force, making even movement very difficult. And the monster was in front of the two of them in an instant, its ferocious eyes gleaming with light, and it looked at Jiang Chen and the two as if it was seeing food.

    "Hey, where did this little kid come from? He dared to massacre the monsters under my throne. Do you really think that I am easy to bully?" The giant monster shouted angrily, uttering human words.

    Jiang Chen and Hu Yun were both stunned, and for a long time they were speechless.

    "Are you two mute? How dare you not answer my question to you? Do you really not take me seriously?" The giant monster roared angrily. The huge sound shook Jiang Chen and Hu Yun's hearts and minds, making it difficult for them to calm down.
